entities.summary: Art and Feminism is a registered 501(c)(3) organization started in 2014 as an annual worldwide edit-a-thon to add content to Wikipedia about women artists. The project has been described as "a massive multinational effort to correct a persistent bias in Wikipedia, which is disproportionately written by and about men".
